profile.org_note: Founder-owned partnership with its own title system. 'Executive Services' (the founding and executive partners) acts as owner and investor and handles corporate strategy and access to capital and land; 'Operations Partners' run centralized functions (for land: the Operations Partner, Land PMO, externally a Vice President of Land); each market team has a 'Market Partner, Land' who runs land development and lot delivery. A Director of Corporate Land Acquisition sets land strategy with 'the Founding Partner'. Land development also runs through an affiliate, Dependable Development Inc. The company publishes no leadership page, so the people holding the land and finance posts are mostly not named in public.
profile.summary: Private, founder-owned semi-custom builder based in Monroe, NC (Charlotte area), building in five Carolinas markets: Charlotte, the Triad, Raleigh, Wilmington and Charleston. It calls itself the largest private builder in the Carolinas, with more than 20,000 homes delivered since its founding (2006 per the company), and trade press reported more than 2,200 annual starts and a lot pipeline above 19,000 lots in January 2026. It is a conventional for-sale builder that entitles and develops much of its own land, with side programs for build-on-your-lot and build-to-rent, and it has said publicly that it works with off-balance-sheet investors and developers for lots, which makes it a plausible land-banking customer.

President / COO: not publicly disclosed. Scott Wentz, called President by BD Magazine in January 2026, is described by the company as a Strategic Advisor.
CFO / head of finance (Executive or Operations Partner of Finance): not publicly disclosed. A third-party contact site showed only initials and was not used.
Treasurer / capital markets: not publicly disclosed.
Head of land (Operations Partner, Land PMO / Vice President of Land) and Director of Corporate Land Acquisition: roles confirmed by job postings (2024 to 2025), holders not publicly named.
Market Partners of Land and market (division) leaders for Charlotte, Triad, Raleigh, Wilmington and Charleston: not publicly named in any source opened.

Orchestrator leads for Upstate SC, Columbia and Myrtle Beach divisions were not confirmed: the company site lists only Charlotte, Triad, Raleigh, Wilmington and Charleston (the Wilmington market reaches Brunswick County towns near Myrtle Beach).

Names in Pro Builder's 2020 Builder of the Year profile (for example an executive partner for people and two market partners) were not carried forward because the source is six years old and no newer confirmation was found.
